judgments.supporting_quote: Remove the liquid by dismantling the pipe plug (3) at the bottom of the pump.
Spray-coat the inside wall of the pumpcasing, and in particular the impeller clearance areas, with a preservative.
Mark valve and head before disassembly to ensure proper reassembly.
Where it is proposed to use the introduction of inert gas into the crankcase to minimize a potential crankcase explosion, details of the arrangements are to be submitted for consideration.
Where necessary, expansion joints are to be protected against mechanical damage.
Unscrew cap nuts (24). Remove washers (24a) and pump casing (29)
All rotating components of the line cutters are to be dynamically balanced at their maximum designed shaft speed.
Fit the 2 set screws (2280) into the sub shaft hub, using Loctite 243
